title: Germany is 'totally controlled' by Russia, Trump says | Squawk Box Europe
summary: A short CNBC clip from 2018 in which President Trump criticizes Germany for paying billions of dollars to Russia for energy, saying Germany is 'totally controlled' by Russia. It comes from a NATO summit news segment.
why: Cited in later threads on Russian gas dependence as an example of Trump's 2018 warning to Germany that proved prescient.

quote.text: warning about German dependence on Russian gas
